rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when a person, situation, or sea becomes calm again.

example.english: After everyone finished arguing, things finally began to subside.
example.traditional: 大家鬧完交，終於平靜返喇。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 naau6 jyun4 gaau1 zung1 jyu1 ping4 zing6 faan2 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the intensity of noise, wind, rain, fire, or a similar thing becomes less strong.

example.english: The rain has begun to subside, so we can go out.
example.traditional: 場雨細返喇，我哋可以出街喇。
example.jyutping: coeng4 jyu6 sai3 faan2 laa3 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 ceot1 gaai1 laa3

rows.note: Use this mainly for symptoms, swelling, pain, or other conditions that gradually go away; it is more common in formal or written contexts.

example.english: The swelling in my ankle finally began to subside after I took the medicine.
example.traditional: 食藥之後，我隻腳眼嘅腫脹終於消退。
example.jyutping: sik6 joek6 zi1 hau6 ngo5 zek3 goek3 ngaan5 ge3 zung2 zoeng3 zung1 jyu1 siu1 teoi3
